title: 2024 Panini Mosaic Green Mosaic #50 Deshaun Watson Cleveland Browns Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2024 Panini Mosaic Deshaun Watson trading card featuring him as a player for the Cleveland Browns in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the Green Mosaic insert set and has a limited print run as a short print (SP) parallel variety. It is made of 35 Pt. card stock with exclusive hologram features, making it a collectors' edition item. The card is an original release by Panini and is part of a set that includes various players from the league, with this specific card numbered as #50.
